newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police arrest 45 alleged mobsters.
newsitem.headline: Italian police arrest 45 alleged mobsters.

text.p: Italian police said on Saturday they had smashed a drugs trafficking ring and arrested 45 alleged mobsters.
Some 200 officers carried out the arrests in and around the city of Agrigento in southeast Sicily and were still looking for four other suspects, police said.
Members of the group, which was not part of the island's main Cosa Nostra Mafia, faced charges of drugs trafficking, extortion and theft, police said.
